meta.note: One record per deal/instrument. Bases are explicit per record (size_basis): face, gross, net, facility, commitment, reported. Announced/committed/reported items carry in_totals=false and are NEVER summed with priced/closed deals. Non-USD deals carry size_usd_bn only where a source gives the USD equivalent (Barclays at-issue or 10-Q carrying value, stated). Project bonds are keyed by the TENANT ticker (issuer named in 'issuer'); roster=false rows are adjacent issuers kept for the pricing map. Credit marks quoted in notes are the official AI_Credit_Live workbook bases: price pts, YTM %, OAS bp (Bloomberg, 2026-11-03 09:34). Boundary rows (window_flag) are listed; only 'boundary-in' rows count in totals. Yet-to-close layer (2026-11-05): ytc_tier tags every announced/signed/committed/planned/reported/tentative-IPO row (1 signed or committed, not closed · 2 programme, option or undrawn capacity · 3 reported or in talks · 4 tentative IPO); ytc_usd_bn is the amount shown in the yet-to-close bar with its ytc_basis, never added to the priced/closed total. cash_pending flags deals already in the priced total whose cash has not yet arrived.
